inputRootSignature: theorem bootstrap_sample_variance_conditional_mean {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (hX_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hX_indep : iIndepFun X P) (hX_ident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn⟩) P P) (hX_sq : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (X ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn⟩ ω) ^ 2) P) (I : Fin n → Ω → Fin n) (hI_meas : ∀ j, Measurable (I j)) (hI_indep : iIndepFun I P) (hI_uniform : ∀ i j, P {ω | I j ω = i} = (n : ENNReal)⁻¹) (hIX_indep : IndepFun (fun ω j ↦ I j ω) (fun ω i ↦ X i ω) P) : let Xstar : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun j ω ↦ X (I j ω) ω let mean : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, X i ω let meanStar : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j, Xstar j ω let V : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (X i ω - mean ω) ^ 2 let Vstar : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j, (Xstar j ω - meanStar ω) ^ 2 let G : MeasurableSpace Ω := MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i ↦ X i ω) (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin n → ℝ)) condExp G P Vstar =ᵐ[P] fun ω ↦ (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) * V ω
